text: Whalesong Studio（鲸歌工坊）是 DeepSeek Harness 的长篇小说创作工坊，在 Web 与桌面客户端提供书架、设置和会话旁创作面板。它把总编、写手、策划、场记、导演和后期等角色接入 Harness 的 agent loop，由总编协调规划、写作与修订，项目状态和故事记忆随章节整理。作者可以管理人物与世界设定、导入已有稿件、生成插画和音频剧，并把作品导出。适合希望持续创作和维护复杂故事设定的小说作者。需要先在 Harness 中配置所选文本、图像或语音模型；具体媒体服务由用户设置。

Whalesong Studio is a fiction studio for DeepSeek Harness, with a writing panel in Web and desktop clients. A showrunner coordinates agent roles for planning, drafting, and revision. Authors can manage story notes, import manuscripts, create illustrations, and export books.

Whalesong Studio 的功能「分角色写作」：总编会将章节工作交给写手模型，并可先规划章节、汇总故事上下文，再保存生成的正文。通过小说家 preset 的会话工具触发。
Whalesong Studio 的功能「管理故事设定」：作者可通过小说工具维护书籍项目、人物与世界资料，并让章节创作读取相关设定，帮助长篇故事延续前文。
Whalesong Studio 的功能「制作插画与音频」：小说家可调用舞台工具生成并保存项目插画，或为章节制作音频剧脚本、生成语音与声音片段。需要配置相应媒体模型。
Whalesong Studio 的功能「导出作品」：导出管线读取已写章节并生成 Markdown 或纯文本等格式，供作者下载和继续使用。

whalesong-studio README · Whalesong Studio：**Write a long novel with a crew of AI agents — a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

whalesong-studio README · Whalesong Studio：**Whalesong Studio** (鲸歌工坊) is for writing long fiction with AI. You talk to a showrunner; behind it, a small crew writes, keeps track of the story, reviews, draws and gives it a voice. Hundreds of thousands of words in, your characters are still themselves and the story still adds up. When the book is done, you can publish it as an illustrated website in one click.

It isn't a role-play front end or a "generate a chapter" button: you make the calls, and each model does the part it is good at.

whalesong-studio README · Whalesong Studio：<sub>*Lewis Carroll's* Alice's Adventures in Wonderland *imported into the Studio, open beside a conversation with the showrunner. Every picture in these screenshots was drawn in the Studio.*</sub>

whalesong-studio README · Whalesong Studio：**See what it makes:** two classics published with Whalesong Studio — read *[Alice's Adventures in Wonderland](https://whalesong.xuhao1.me/books/alice/)* or *[Dream of the Red Chamber](https://whalesong.xuhao1.me/books/hongloumeng/)* (红楼梦, in Chinese) online. The first chapters can be listened to as well — the first three of *Alice*, the first ten of 红楼梦 — voiced by the Studio. Once inside, click **People** and **World** at the top: every character has a page of their own, the main ones with portraits, and the places can be walked into one inside another.
whalesong-studio README · Whalesong Studio：> **New here?** The [tutorial](./docs/tutorial.md) walks you through it with screenshots, from installing to your first illustrated chapter.

whalesong-studio README · A crew, not a single model：Models that plan well and use tools well rarely write beautiful prose, and the best prose writers rarely manage a big project well. So Whalesong Studio doesn't ask one model to do everything:
section: A crew, not a single model

text:
whalesong-studio README · A crew, not a single model：| Role | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Showrunner** (总编) | The one you talk to, on any model you like. Works out what you want, plans what comes next, hands out the work and reports back. It never writes the story itself. |
| **Writer** (写手) | Writes the prose, on a model you choose. Before every chapter it is handed everything that chapter needs: the setting, where each character stands, what came before, the open threads, the outline and the style. |
| **Continuity** (场记) | Remembers. After every chapter it notes what happened and how everyone has changed. It also reviews like an editor — and when it says something contradicts an earlier chapter, it shows you the passage. |
| **Planner** (策划) | Has the ideas. Works out what could happen next, fleshes out the characters and the world, tries "what if…" turns of the story, and can look things up on the web. |
| **Director** (导演) | Sound and pictures. Adapts chapters into audio drama and storyboards, and plays everyone else when you step into a scene as one of the characters. |
| **Post-production** (后期) | Edits voices, sound and pictures into a video, checks the result itself, and
section: A crew, not a single model

text: whalesong-studio README · A crew, not a single model：The four crew members are real agents running on DeepSeek Harness's own agent loop, and every job they do leaves a full record in your conversation: what they looked up, what they handed in, what it cost. Prefer buttons to chat? Everything can be done from the Studio's own screens, too.
section: A crew, not a single model

text: whalesong-studio README · Hundreds of thousands of words in, nothing is forgotten：After every chapter the Studio notes what happened, where each character stands and which threads moved. When the next chapter is written, the writer gets a summary of everything before plus the last few chapters in full — the whole book, while it's short enough — along with any earlier passages that matter. A style profile keeps the voice steady. Ask for what comes next, a fix to a paragraph, a rewrite of a chapter or one change carried through the whole book: every change is shown to you first, side by side, and the previous version is always kept.
section: Hundreds of thousands of words in, nothing is forgotten

text: whalesong-studio README · Every character gets a page, every place can be explored：Each character has a card — personality, relationships, what they go through in the book, how they look and sound — and every later picture and spoken line follows it. Places nest inside one another: Wonderland holds the hall of doors, the wood, the garden and the March Hare's house. Beside the text, **People** shows each character's page with a large portrait, and **World** opens any place to show its picture, what it contains and who lives there.

text: whalesong-studio README · Read it, hear it, watch it：A reader with careful typography and the book's own pictures in the text; one switch turns it into an audiobook, with every character keeping one voice through the whole book. Pictures stay consistent too: each character first gets a design sheet — front, side and back — and every later picture is drawn to match. Go further with an **audio drama**, a **motion comic** that plays along with the voices, a chapter cut into a **video**, or an **interlude** — play one of the characters in a scene while the others answer you.

text: whalesong-studio README · Publish it as a work of digital art：When the book is ready, publish it as a website in one click: the text set for reading, a portrait and a short biography for every character, and places your readers can step into. Nothing to install, and it reads well on a phone. The two classics linked above were made exactly this way.
section: Publish it as a work of digital art

text: whalesong-studio README · Bring in a book you've already written：Drop in a `.txt`, `.md`, `.epub` or `.docx`. The Studio finds the chapters, sorts out the characters and the world, rebuilds the outline and learns the style — then you can carry on writing, revise it, or turn it into an audio drama. The screenshots on this page are *Alice's Adventures in Wonderland* imported this way; the Chinese README shows *Dream of the Red Chamber*.

text:
whalesong-studio README · Yours, on your own machine：- **Your book is an ordinary folder** of Markdown and JSON. Edit it in the Studio, in your own editor or through the showrunner — all three see the same files, and it works well with git.
- **Branching plots**: try another way the story could go on a branch; whichever works better becomes the main line, and nothing you wrote is lost.
- **On your phone** over Wi-Fi with one button, read-only or editable.
- **Private books**: lock a book — text, pictures, audio and your conversations about it — behind a password or your computer's own unlock.
- **Export** to Markdown, plain text, HTML or EPUB, and see **usage and cost** per model, book and day.
whalesong-studio README · Yours, on your own machine：Everything it does, in full: **[docs/features.md](./docs/features.md)**.
whalesong-studio README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later (`< 0.3`). It works in the Desktop app and the Web UI (`dsh web`).
whalesong-studio README · Desktop app：The Desktop app owns its `desktop` profile, so plugins are installed from inside the app — `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` is refused by design.
whalesong-studio README · Desktop app：To upgrade, uninstall the plugin on the same page and add the new version. Your books are ordinary directories in your workspaces and are not touched.

whalesong-studio README · Web UI and other profiles：`dsh plugin` runs pnpm, which must be on your `PATH`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/whalesong-studio-0.1.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web remove whalesong-studio
```

A built checkout path or `github:xuhao1/whalesong-studio` works in place of the tarball; for the latter pnpm must be allowed to run the build script, see [Package and install a plugin](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish).

whalesong-studio README · Building it yourself：Needs Node.js 22+.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xuhao1/whalesong-studio.git
cd whalesong-studio
npm install     # installs dependencies; builds lib/ when the checkout has none
npm pack        # writes whalesong-studio-<version>.tgz
whalesong-studio README · Quick start：The [tutorial](./docs/tutorial.md) does the same step by step, with screenshots; this is the short version.

whalesong-studio README · Quick start：1. Open **Whalesong Studio** in the left sidebar. The first time, it asks you to **connect the models**: pick a service, paste one API key and click **Set up** — pictures, voices and search are configured at once. Writing uses the text models you already have in DeepSeek Harness, so you can also skip this and come back later. **With ChatGPT Plus or Pro**, press **Sign in with ChatGPT and set up** on the first card and sign in once in the browser: writing and pictures are both connected, no key ([step by step](./docs/chatgpt.md)).
2. **Start a new book** from a sentence or a paragraph about the story. Tick "draft the foundation" and the planner proposes a premise, the main characters, the world, volumes and the opening chapters — all yours to change. Or **bring in a book you've written** by dropping in the file.
3. Start a session with the **小说家 Novelist** preset and say what you want: "write chapter two and end it on the knock at the door", "the villain feels flat — give him a reason", "what if she turns the deal down?", "make chapter one into an audio drama". The Studio opens beside the conversation as soon as the work starts.
4. Read the chap

whalesong-studio README · Quick start：In the message box, `/novel status`, `/novel mode <ideate|bible|outline|draft|revise|review|stage|play>`, `/novel digest` and `/novel export <format>` work as well.

whalesong-studio README · Configuration：Everything lives in *Whalesong Studio → Settings*, and the showrunner will change any of it for you if you ask. **Writing uses DeepSeek Harness's own models** — whatever you've connected under its *Settings → Models*; in the Studio you just choose which role uses which. **A ChatGPT subscription** is the exception: DSH can sign in to ChatGPT by itself but has no page that starts it — the ChatGPT card on the Studio's guide page does, and one sign-in adds the route to DSH and gives the roles GPT models ([On ChatGPT Plus / Pro](./docs/chatgpt.md)). The Studio itself only needs models for pictures, voices and search, and one key sets them all up:

whalesong-studio README · What is sent where：- Text goes to the models you chose for the roles: a role that follows the conversation model or uses a Harness model goes through the Harness LLM runtime (the same routes, credentials and retry policy as your conversations); a role with an endpoint of its own is called by the Studio directly.
- Image prompts, the text of lines to be spoken and (if enabled) text chunks to be embedded go to the media endpoints you configured. Nothing is sent to any endpoint you did not configure; there is no telemetry.
- Keys stay in the Harness credential store on your machine and are only ever sent to the endpoint host they were entered for.
- Books stay in your workspace. Settings live in `$DSH_HOME/novel-writer/`.
